claim: NYMEX (CME Group) voluntarily consents to a further 60-day CFTC review extension for its Silicon Data H100 (GPU1) and B200 (GPU2) compute futures, moving the decision date from 2026-11-09 to 2027-01-08; the extension is conditioned on no other CFTC registrant self-certifying, obtaining approval, or listing a comparable contract during the period (an earlier date would control)

CFTC delayed approval of GPU rental futures, citing liquidity and price-manipulation risk from opaque, concentrated pricing indexes; regulator plans further meetings with benchmark providers, pushing a first compute-futures market to early 2027 at the earliest; DRW, Jump Trading and a16z are pressing for approval

Ornn is in the midst of a triple-tranche funding round at a top valuation of ~$1B, with Thrive Capital and General Catalyst in talks to participate; follows its $33M seed led by a16z crypto in June 2026

Anthropic says it will not terminate its ~$41.3B compute agreement with Lambda despite Lambda missing a deadline to secure a Texas data-center lease (the $34.9B GPU-services portion carried a termination option); Lambda is pursuing up to $4B in private financing ahead of a possible 2027 IPO

RunPod partners with RUTILEA to expand AI compute capacity in Asia; RUTILEA becomes RunPod's exclusive Japan partner for sourcing and onboarding data-center capacity onto the RunPod platform, with plans to grow across Asia

Index divergence persists: Ornn's OCPI-H100 printed $3.25/GPU-hr as of 2026-11-11, while on 2026-11-08 Silicon Data's SDH100RT read ~$3.00 and Ornn read $3.37 - roughly 12% apart on the same chip and date (settlement-reference risk)

Hyperbolic's $30M Series A1 detailed (2026-11-06): aggregating 300+ GPU cloud providers for 250k+ builders via its Forge control plane, with a planned Global Compute Grid adding spot instances, dynamic pricing, market-making and compute-price hedging

SF Compute operates a physically-settled forwards market that has cleared several hundred million dollars of volume and is positioning the GPU hour as loan collateral, acting as an independent servicer that operates but does not own the clusters it sells

ICE x Ornn OCPI H100 (HPR) and B200 (BKL) compute futures: no listing date - ICE published hypothetical daily settlement prices on its platform from 2026-10-05, listing remains subject to completion of the CFTC process
Nodal Exchange x Compute Desk GPU compute futures suite: no launch date, CFTC filing, or update found this week (announced 2026-09-03)
CFTC compute-derivatives RFC (docket CFTC-2026-1850) remains closed since 2026-10-20; published comments now 108 (was 107 on 2026-11-02); no Commission decision announced

Kalshi operates CFTC-regulated event contracts on GPU rental prices (since March 2026) and published the first market-implied GPU compute forward curve on 2026-07-14 for Nvidia B200, H200 and A100, referencing Ornn's live-trade index

Nvidia signed non-binding MOUs (2026-08-10) with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to mobilize $500B+ in AI data-center financing with Nvidia GPUs as loan collateral, Nvidia guaranteeing up to 25% of any resale-value decline
CoreWeave carries ~$35B of debt (~25% of revenue to interest); credit analysts put total neocloud GPU-backed debt outstanding above $20B once private facilities are included

Silicon Data raised a $30.5M Series A in August 2026 from Valor Equity Partners and Atreides Management's joint AI fund; it aims to be a pure data/benchmark play (publishes the SDH100RT index used by CME)
Ornn raised a $33M seed led by a16z crypto (June 2026) to build a GPU compute marketplace and secondary/derivatives trading on its OCPI benchmark
Prime Intellect raised a $130M Series A led by Radical Ventures (with Nvidia Ventures, Intel Capital, Dell Technologies Capital), valuing it at $1B and bringing total funding past $150M (July 2026)

Architect Financial Technologies acquired a US Designated Contract Market (IMX Health) to launch the American Innovation Exchange, a CFTC-regulated venue for compute and AI-supply-chain futures/options; its AX exchange already trades compute perpetuals outside the US (since January 2026)
Architect launched Liquid Inference, a real-time exchange for AI inference, expanding the AI Exchange stack (2026-10-07, pending regulatory review)
ICE announced a separate compute futures suite with NATIVX based on NATIVX's COIL Index (price of tokenized, energy-normalized compute and connectivity) (2026-07-01); no launch yet
CME/NYMEX filed two compute futures (Silicon Data H100 GPU1, B200 GPU2) with the CFTC on 2026-08-11 (Submission 26-370): 730 GPU-hours per contract, $7.30/tick, 36-month listing cycle, cash-settled
source: CME Group Special Executive Report 9785 / press release (primary, 2026-08-11)

claim: CFTC issued a Request for Comment on the listing of compute derivatives (2026-08-19, Federal Register 2026-08-21); comments closed 2026-10-20
Nodal Exchange and Compute Desk announced a suite of GPU compute futures settling against Compute Desk's blended daily indexes (2026-09-03); not yet launched
Spot GPU rental spreads remain wide (~25x from budget spot to hyperscaler); H100 on-demand rates have declined from the 2023 peak and continue to drift lower as Blackwell supply builds
